description:
## [0.22.5](https://github.com/Forsigh/waze-patches/compare/v0.22.4...v0.22.5) (2026-10-13)

### 🗑️ Removed

* **AMOLED dark mode** is removed. On-device testing once more showed the app failing at startup
  with the row ticked - a loading screen, then an error, then exit - so the skin-value rewrite is
  retired for good: the night skins ship exactly as Waze builds them, and nothing overrides them at
  patch time

patches.name: Allow high refresh rate
patches.description: Waze rejects any display mode above 60 Hz when it picks the mode for its surface, so a 120 Hz screen is served 60 Hz. This raises that ceiling to the requested rate (120 Hz by default). Costs battery and heat - off by default.

options.description: The ceiling Waze accepts when choosing a display mode. 120 suits most modern panels; 90 or 60 to back off if the phone throttles.

patches.name: Auto zoom
patches.description: Keeps the auto-zoom mode you pick (no / yes / speed) from being overwritten when Waze syncs its server config. The setting comes from Waze itself; this makes it stick.

options.description: speed = zoom out progressively with speed, yes = always on, no = off.

patches.name: Average-speed camera alerts
patches.description: Turns on average-speed camera alerts and the recommended speed for the zone.

patches.name: Brief voice guidance
patches.description: Enables Waze's brief voice-guidance mode, which trims the spoken directions down.

patches.name: Disable Play Store updates
patches.description: Stops the Play Store from offering or applying updates to Waze: the manifest version code is locked above Play's maximum (2,100,000,000 + minutes), so the store always sees the installed copy as newer than its listing. The value advances on every re-patch, so Waze still refreshes its extracted resources, and Waze's own package-version accessor keeps reporting the pre-lock code. Ported from Morphe's universal "Disable Play Store updates" (GPLv3).

patches.name: Enable police & enforcement alerts
patches.description: Turns on Waze's police and enforcement alerts.

patches.name: Extended police & hazard alert distances
patches.description: Alerts for police, accidents and heavy traffic fire earlier, with their pre-alert distances extended.

patches.name: Lane guidance
patches.description: Turns on lane guidance, including the continue-straight hints.

patches.name: Morphe YouTube Music as a Waze audio partner
patches.description: Makes Morphe YouTube Music (app.morphe.android.apps.youtube.music) usable as Waze's audio partner: the package is declared in Waze's manifest so Android's package visibility lets Waze see it, and it is added to the audio-partner table (SdkConfiguration.appConfigs) whenever Waze rebuilds that roster. Ported from Loupric/morphe-waze-music-patch (GPLv3).

patches.name: Radar sound at any speed
patches.description: Plays the speed-camera alert sound even when you are not over the limit. Waze normally only sounds it when you are.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Forces Waze's advertising settings off, so the ad slots that respect those values stay empty.

patches.name: Show all cameras & road hazards
patches.description: Draws speed cameras, red-light cameras and speed bumps on the map, with their on-route notifications enabled.

patches.name: Speed limit sign always shown
patches.description: The speed-limit sign stays on the map, and its manual overrides become available.

patches.name: Speed-limit decrease warnings
patches.description: Warns when the posted speed limit drops, with a longer pre-alert distance than stock.

patches.name: Speedometer always on
patches.description: The speedometer stays on screen at any speed, including when stopped. Waze hides it below its own minimum speed otherwise.

patches.name: Unlock driver moods
patches.description: Waze's mood picker is gated three ways: an eligibility check that accepts only one mood name (and reads the beta-moods flag), a baby-account gate that hides moods, and a filtered native catalogue call. This opens all three, so moods already in the local catalogue - including special and hidden entries - become selectable. Artwork Waze has never downloaded is not invented.
